text:
Total consideration to target shareholders consists of $41.00 per share in cash, net to the seller, plus one CVR per share; i.e., the Offer Price equals the Cash Amount plus one CVR (and may be higher if the Offer Price increases). The Merger Consideration is the Offer Price; there is no stock consideration described for the target's holders.
Cash Amount: $41.00 per share, net to the seller in cash, without interest thereon and subject to Sections 1.1(g) and 2.11; CVR: one CVR per share of Company Common Stock; Merger Consideration (Offer Price): Cash Amount plus one CVR per share (or any higher price as may be paid in the Offer); Stock exchange ratio: for Purchaser's capital stock, each share outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time shall be converted into one share of Surviving Corporation (1-for-1); Other forms of consideration: CVR-based Milestone Payments under the CVR Agreement; Dissenting Shares shall not be entitled to CVRs.
Not a fixed exchange ratio is stated. Each share of Company Common Stock automatically converts into the right to receive the Merger Consideration (a cash amount per share plus CVRs) as defined in the Recitals, with Dissenting Shares not entitled to CVRs.
